instruction: Tag all emails in the Bills folder as important

rules.sql: select (select count(*) from messages where folderID = 13) = (select count(distinct messageID) from messageAttributes where attributeID = 18 and value = 1 and messageID in (select id from messages where folderID = 13));

metadata.explanation: Task requires marking all emails in the Bills folder (folderID=13) as important. The evaluator checks if ALL emails in folder 13 have the important attribute (attributeID=18) set to 1 by comparing the total count of emails in the folder with the count of emails that have the important attribute. This is verified via SQL query on the Thunderbird global-messages-db.sqlite database.

llm_judge_reasons: SQL query correctly verifies that ALL emails in Bills folder (folderID=13) are tagged as important
Logic: Compares total email count in folder 13 with count of emails that have attributeID=18 (important flag) set to value=1
Returns 1 (true) only when both counts are equal, meaning every email in the folder has the important attribute
Complete coverage: Checks both the folder constraint and the important attribute requirement
Edge case handled correctly: Empty folder (0=0) evaluates to true, which is semantically correct (vacuous truth)
Postconfig properly closes Thunderbird to ensure database is flushed before verification
